site.title: StudentHub
site.heading: Student Hub
welcomeText: StudentHub is the official digital gateway for university students, faculty, and campus administrators. Designed to streamline academic workflows and foster a vibrant campus community, StudentHub brings together everything you need for a successful academic journey in one place.

Through this portal, students can easily track course schedules, register for upcoming skill-building workshops, access digital library archives, monitor examination results, and manage their personal academic profiles with ease.

features.title: Event & Workshop Management
features.description: Stay informed about upcoming hands-on technical bootcamps, guest lectures, cultural conventions, and sports meets. Register with a single click and receive calendar reminders.

features.title: Student Performance Dashboard
features.description: Track your academic progress in real-time. View subject-wise attendance percentages, assignment submission deadlines, SGPA/CGPA breakdown, and downloadable grade cards.

features.title: Peer Collaboration & Mentorship
features.description: Connect with faculty mentors, join project study groups, collaborate on open-source repositories, and participate in peer-to-peer learning forums.

features.title: Central Resource Library
features.description: Access syllabus copies, previous years' question papers, recommended reference books, lab manuals, and video lectures uploaded directly by department professors.

events.title: Full-Stack Web Development Workshop 2026
events.description: Join our intensive 1-day hands-on workshop on modern web technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, and responsive web design. All attendees will build a live portfolio project and receive a certificate of completion.

events.title: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Seminar
events.description: Industry leaders from leading technology companies will discuss neural networks, deep learning applications in healthcare and robotics, and career roadmaps in AI engineering.

events.title: Annual Hackathon - Code For Future 4.0
events.description: Form teams of up to 4 members to solve real-world industry challenges in Smart Education, Healthcare, and Sustainable Tech. Mentors will be present throughout the event.

guidelines.title: Attendance Requirement
guidelines.description: Minimum 75% attendance is mandatory in theory and practical sessions to be eligible for end-semester examinations.

guidelines.title: Lab Submission Timelines
guidelines.description: All lab manuals and code assignments must be submitted to the respective portal folder by Friday 5:00 PM.

guidelines.title: Identity Cards
guidelines.description: Carrying your official university RFID Student ID card is compulsory while inside campus premises, library, and examination halls.

guidelines.title: Library Book Retention
guidelines.description: Students can borrow up to 4 books simultaneously for a maximum duration of 14 days without late renewal fees.

notices.title: Lab Submission Deadline
notices.description: Department of Computer Engineering practical journals due by Friday, 5:00 PM.

notices.title: Workshop Registration Open
notices.description: Seats are filling fast for the Web Development Bootcamp. Register via the Events tab.

notices.title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule
notices.description: Tentative timetables for B.Tech Semester III & V have been published on the bulletin board.

notices.title: Scholarship Application Window
notices.description: Merit cum means financial assistance forms are open until August 30.

notices.title: Sports Club Tryouts
notices.description: Basketball and Table Tennis team selections will commence this Saturday at the Campus Sports Complex.

support.title: Need Assistance? Student Support Helpdesk
support.description: If you encounter technical issues with portal login, course registration, or fee payments, please contact our helpdesk.
support.office: Student Activity Center, Block B, Room 102
